name: Lumina Context Engine
description: Context engine that keeps legacy message assembly and adds Lumina's recall routing and abstention rules to every run.

abstention.description: Tell the model to say it does not know instead of guessing when recall returns nothing.

wikiRouting.description: Point the model at the Memory Wiki (entities, concepts, procedures) for curated knowledge.

promptAppend.description: Extra guidance appended to every run's system prompt.
